entity_noun: certification, accreditation, registration, standard, or compliance

sections.heading: For each distinct {{entity_noun}} you identify, this must hold:

rules.text: The record's mentions evidence the {{entity_noun}} you identified — it is named, described, or clearly implied by what the mentions say, not merely suggested by a resemblance between words.

children.text: Whose {{entity_noun}} it is has no bearing here. A candidate evidenced by a customer's, supplier's, or any other third party's dealings is still identified and recorded.

The {{entity_noun}} must be identifiable by its own name, number, or issuing body from the record. Meeting a customer's or an industry's specifications, or operating quality assurance systems, is not itself a nameable {{entity_noun}} — never substitute a named standard the record does not name. A statement of commitment, values, or goals, or general praise of quality, reliability, or standing, names nothing that could specifically be held, met, or followed, and identifies no {{entity_noun}}.

sections.heading: Match each {{entity_noun}} you identified by the first of these rules that applies, in order:

rules.text: An option whose meaning exactly matches the identified {{entity_noun}} is chosen.

children.text: Choose by comparing the identified {{entity_noun}} against {{option_evidence}}, never by lexical or name similarity, and without forced or contrived links that rely on assumptions beyond the record. In particular, do not choose an option whose name resembles the identified {{entity_noun}} when {{option_evidence}} does not cover this case.

rules.text: When no option exactly matches, an option whose meaning generalizes the identified {{entity_noun}} is chosen.

children.text: Every entry in the outline is one you may choose, including an entry that has entries indented beneath it. Where the record evidences something the outline covers only at a broader entry, that broader entry is the match.
